Thank you Nishnai team, Aniket, Praveen, Sanika, Babubhai, & Pallavi for giving us the opportunity to visit and explore Rajasthan - Jodhpur and Jaisalmer and making our tour successful.  This was my 2nd trip with Nishnai Holidays.  The tour started with travelling via Suryanagari Express on 5 March 2026.   I joined the tour as a solo traveler but met a group of friendly people.  Everyone seemed energetic and excited about tour; had been making reels, playing antakshari, dancing on Music.  At Jodhpur, we visited Mehrangarh Fort, Museum, other places, and explored local market best known for handcrafts.   The guides provided us the facts, the historical information about the places.  At Jaisalmer, we visited Sonar fort, Patwon ki Haveli and explored many antique things including utensils, gramophone, telephone, furniture, kerosene fridge, etc.  We visited Bada Bagh, and kuldhara village and learned the history behind its curse.  We enjoyed sam dunes, tent stay, camel ride, Rajasthani cultural program, music, and dinner.   The meals were good along with chaas and desserts.  All hotel rooms were clean, spacious, and royal with good water supply and geyser and AC facility.   Transport AC bus was excellent. I enjoyed the tour and Womens Day celebration with cake, games, reels, and lots of fun.
💯 Value for money.
💯 recommended

*5/5 Stars - Exceptional Family Holiday with Urvi Tours!*

We recently returned from an unforgettable 11-night family holiday to Iceland with Urvi Tours, and I must say it was truly a trip of a lifetime! The overall rating of 5/5 is well-deserved, thanks to the exceptional service provided by the tour company.

Our tour leader, Nayan Soni, was outstanding - his knowledge and expertise in Iceland are unparalleled. He ensured that every moment of our trip was memorable, from the breathtaking landscapes to the thrilling experiences.

The food was excellent, and we were pleasantly surprised by the picnic lunches, which were often better than regular lunches provided by other tour companies. The Kolkata pan was a lovely touch!

One of the highlights of our trip was witnessing the breathtaking Northern Lights, which we were fortunate to see four times. Initially, we were worried that we might miss this natural wonder, but Nayan ensured that we made the most of our time in Iceland.

In terms of value for money, this tour exceeded our expectations. The attention to detail, the quality of services, and the unforgettable experiences made every penny worthwhile.

I highly recommend Urvi Tours to anyone planning a trip to Iceland or any other destination. Their exceptional service, knowledgeable tour leaders, and commitment to excellence make them a top-notch tour company.

Planning & Coordination:
From the very beginning, Prabhu Travels was highly responsive and attentive to our preferences. While going to Coorg we visited Vishnu and Laxmi Temple in Srirangapatna. The temple is very nice. And then Tipu Sultan Palace.
We were brought to our resort. The Porcupine Castle Resort is wonderful. Rajguru Tours booked two rooms with Mountain View for us. The view was very nice. Food quality was very delicious and excellent. Hotel staff are very polite.
Next day we went to Raja Seat were we captured multiple photos. Then we went for coffee plantation tour were guide explained us about different types of trees, coffees, spices. After visiting the Golden Temple and Tibetean Monestry we went to Nisargadhama. There we visited the Nisargadhama Bird Park. In the bird park there are different types of birds available. And even there is a place to feed the birds.
Then we went to Dubare Elephant Camp. The elephant camp is must visit place. There are around 27 elephants. To visit that camp you need to travel by boat and the ticket booking for the same starts at 4.00 PM.
After completing the Dubare Elephant Camp we came back to resort and we had our dinner.
Next day we relaxed at the resort.
And on the last day we started our journey back from Coorg to Bangalore airport.
The service of Rajguru Tours was spotless! Specially Mrs. Trupti Ma'am s co-ordination with us from start to end was excellent. She took utmost care of us.

featured_reviews.name: Poulomi Saha
featured_reviews.review_text:
Bhakti and the Eastern Travels team transformed our special celebration into a front-row seat to nature’s greatest reality show! Like nature’s bingo, we checked off the “Big 5” and also spotted the delightfully named “Ugly 5.” The game drives were spectacular – we witnessed incredible wildlife in their natural habitat. We saw lions in double digits lounging like royalty, elephants commandeering the savanna highways, giraffes gracefully ambling across the landscape, and yes, we even saw a real “zebra crossing”!

Our guide John was knowledgeable and passionate, sharing fascinating insights about the ecosystem and local culture. He was an absolute superstar with an uncanny ability to spot a leopard at 200 meters. We encountered not one but two elusive leopards, proving that even the most camera-shy cats can’t resist a good photoshoot when the lighting is right!

We really appreciate how Bhakti and her team went the extra mile to make our special family occasion even more memorable. Her team outdid themselves by meticulously planning and executing the celebration with energy and care. Kudos to Bhakti and the whole Eastern Travels team!

Between witnessing the Great Migration’s drama, learning traditional fire-starting (harder than YouTube makes it look), and understanding why cattle equal currency, we gained new perspectives on how to elevate the art of living authentically.

Here’s a painting I created, inspired by life in the savanna!

featured_reviews.name: Suketu Doshi
featured_reviews.review_text:
My Wife Zarna and i,(mid 60s, Vegetarian) had a very enjoyable and pleasant experience on our 12 day holiday in Switzerland towards the end of May,  organized by Eastern Travels
The locations of the chosen hotels were extremely convenient from the perspective of proximity to the Rail stations, restaurants and general conveniences, and the rooms very comfortable, a couple of them had great views
The itinerary and sightseeing schedules ensured that we weren’t rushed at all and allowed for plenty of flexibility.
It was a wonderful change to be parked in the fabulously pretty quiet country small town Grindelwald for 4 nights as against the bustling crowded Interlaken, with equally easy access to various locales.
We thoroughly enjoyed visiting various small towns/quasi villages like, Brienz, Lavaux, Lauterbrunnen (lovely easy walks through flower filled meadows with the back drop of numerous waterfalls) , Gruyere ( much more to it than the cheese factory) Broc ( Cailler chocolate factory and more ) ; apart from the very well known tourist hotspots .
The quality of the food (though expensive) was outstanding, the ingredients, especially the cheeses ( as in the Fondue and Raclette), herbs   and the vegetables top class
Big shout of thanks for team Eastern especially Ms Nupur, Ms Tamasha and Mr Soumya for putting it all together.

Overall a very memorable holiday, especially being our first time in Kashmir.
